mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, name, transport_type, endpoint_url, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_servers ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, name, transport_type, endpoint_url, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.TransportType}, #{params.EndpointURL,sensitive=true}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_servers SET deleted_at = COALESCE(deleted_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM mcp_servers
workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( POSITION(LOWER(#{params.Search,sensitive=true}) IN LOWER(name)) > 0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{params.Search,sensitive=true}) IN LOWER(endpoint_url)) > 0 )
AND (created_at, uuid) < (#{params.Cursor.CreatedAt}, #{params.Cursor.UUID})
ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{params.FetchLimit}
